## Description

Filtered unique index on (doctor_id, location_id, slot_start) for non-cancelled appointments; booking inside a SERIALIZABLE transaction with sp_getapplock on "doctor:{id}:{date}"; the frontend check is only a convenience. Multi-slot visits reserve every covered slot.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An automated test fires 100 parallel booking attempts at one slot; exactly one succeeds and 99 receive a clear "slot no longer available" error (exit gate 2), on Testcontainers SQL Server and on staging.
- [ ] **AC2.** Overlapping multi-slot bookings are rejected the same way.
- [ ] **AC3.** Deadlocks/lock timeouts are retried safely without creating duplicates.
- [ ] **AC4.** The test runs in CI on every PR touching Scheduling.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
